name: The Giant Guardian
summary: Rockbiter searches for Shay, the night elf girl he was meant to watch over. Worried, he asks you to look for her.

sections.title: Gone While His Back Was Turned
sections.body: Rockbiter last saw Shay while they walked through the ruins just north of where he stands. Then he turned around, and she was gone. Unsure what to do, he asks you to search for his little friend. Your legs can carry you much faster than his.

sections.title: When You Find Her
sections.body: Shay is glad you found her. A little lost, she still cannot help remarking on what a beautiful place this is.

faq.answer: Rockbiter is looking for Shay, a little night elf girl and his friend. He was meant to watch over her.
Rockbiter last saw Shay as they walked through the ruins just north of where he stands.

faq.q: Why does Rockbiter ask someone else to search?
faq.answer: Rockbiter is worried and unsure what to do. He thinks your legs can carry you much faster than his.
